title: The House of Marrow Creek
author: Jude Crane
blurb: Rafael Vasquez, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
